topic: Refactoring SQL for traffic prediction model
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on a Pull Request (PR) submitted by [p1] containing refactored SQL code intended to speed up the `ml_traffic_predictions` process. [p1] confirmed that these changes do not affect results, as they were tested on staging. After review and minor adjustments, [me] approved merging the PR. Later, [p1] mentioned a separate plan to clean up unnecessary elements from `ml_traffic_predictions`, which will result in another PR. Additionally, [p1] proposed splitting the `ml_predictions` into multiple stages and moving linear model coefficients from AWS into ClickHouse tables.
decisions: The refactored SQL code for `ml_traffic_predictions` was approved for merging.
